g.text: 1 · Divide the display into a grid
2 · Give each app a zone (the rest go to the dynamic zone)
3 · Apps open right in their zone
Two windows in one zone: tabs
⌃⌥F · Focus mode: the window grows, the rest is dimmed
Click another window: it goes back to its place
Open the laptop: the two-screen layout takes over
Close it: everything goes back to the monitor, by itself
⌃⌥0 · Another profile (Work): every app somewhere else
Every app opens right in its zone
